title: Which shape repeats in the pinwheel?
description: The pinwheel of the book is drawn with its hexagon in the middle. The shape stuck to each side of the hexagon is picked out and followed as it goes round the boundary. The video ends with the rangoli of the book, whose red petals come back onto themselves after a turn.
teaching_notes: One idea: symmetry means a part of the figure repeats in a definite pattern, and here one shape repeats round the hexagon. Watch for students who look at the whole picture instead of the hexagon and one shape on its side.

source: Look at the pinwheel picture (a blue figure made of many tria

video_script.payoff_line: The same shape repeats all round the hexagon

final_answer.value: The same shape of triangles is stuck to each side of the hexagon and repeats in the same way, turned a little each time

video_script.design: The pinwheel with the hexagon outlined, then one shape on a side coloured, then the same shape coloured on every side. The video ends with the rangoli of the book, whose red petals come back onto themselves.
